title: Chromatic Noshift
summary: The chromatic redshift philosophy, introduced by Ausoni and Rognes, suggests that algebraic $K$-theory raises chromatic height by $1$. We show that the analogue of this philosophy fails in the case of rigid symmetric monoidal stable $\infty$-categories. More precisely, we construct examples of rigid $T(n)$-local categories $C$ where a refinement $\mathrm{Dim}$ of the dimension morphism induces an equivalence $$K(C)\to \mathrm{End}(\mathbf{1}_C)^{BS^1}$$ and for which $K(C)$ therefore vanishes $T(n+1)$-locally.
